### OneWater Marine Inc. Extends Term Loan and Floor Plan Credit Facilities to 2029


November 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/152766675/files/doc_news/OneWater-Marine-Inc--Extends-Term-Loan-and-Floor-Plan-Credit-Facilities-to-2029-2026.pdf)


*Increases Floor Plan Capacity by $50 Million with New Lender Joining Syndicate*


BUFORD, Ga.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


OneWater Marine Inc. (NASDAQ: ONEW) (“OneWater” or the “Company”) today announced that it has amended its senior secured term loan and floor plan financing facilities to extend both maturities by two years and increase floor plan capacity by $50 million. Key terms:


- Term loan maturity extended by two years to July 31, 2029
- Floor plan maturity extended by two years to March 1, 2029
- Floor plan inventory financing capacity increased by $50 million to up to $547 million


“Extending maturities for both facilities and expanding our floor plan capacity reflect our progress in strengthening our balance sheet and the continued support of our lending partners. The amendments give us added flexibility to effectively manage our inventory as we navigate this challenging retail environment. As we move into fiscal 2027, we remain focused on maintaining proper inventory levels and fortifying the balance sheet,” said Jack Ezzell, Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer of OneWater.


Truist Bank leads the senior secured term loan and Wells Fargo leads the floor plan facility. Both remain subject to customary financial and non-financial covenants.


**About OneWater Marine Inc.** OneWater Marine Inc. is one of the largest and fastest-growing premium marine retailers in the United States. OneWater operates a total of 88 retail locations, 6 distribution centers / warehouses and multiple online marketplaces in 17 different states, several of which are in the top twenty states for marine retail expenditures. OneWater offers a broad range of products and services and has diversified revenue streams, which include the sale of new and pre-owned boats, finance and insurance products, parts and accessories, maintenance, repair and other services.
